spec: AC-PC4 calibration corpus for the semantic-cache distance gate (qa-lead)
comment: Cases are deterministic: each embedding is derived from its seed string via
then normalized. A 'near' case pairs a base vector u with a perturbation p
(built from near_seed) combined as u*cos(a) + p*sin(a) so the expected cosine
distance is 1 - cos(a) by construction; 'independent' pairs use two unrelated
seeds. The gate asserts pgvector's <=> distance matches the analytic value
and that the committed threshold classifies every case exactly as 'expected'.
provisional_max_cosine_distance gates the FILTER MECHANICS only. The production
calibrated threshold is ratified by AC-PC4 (dba EXPLAIN/latency limb + false-hit
review) and must replace this value before SEMANTIC_CACHE_ENABLED is ever
flipped on; changing this file's threshold alone does not enable the cache.
